jobs.description:
**Job Title: Onboarding \& Prescreen Specialist**

**Location:** 1485 Richardson Dr. Suite 170, Richardson Tx 75080

**Job Type:** Full Time (M\-F in office 7am\-4pm) This is not a remote position.

**Are you a master multitasker who loves setting people up for success?**

We are looking for a high\-energy, ultra\-organized **Onboarding \& Prescreen Specialist** to join our fast\-growing team. In this role, you will be the face of our company for incoming talent, guiding candidates seamlessly from their very first interview through their first official days on the job.

If you thrive in a **fast\-paced environment**, naturally catch the tiny details others miss, and can orchestrate complex calendars without dropping a single ball, we want to talk to you!

**What You’ll Do (The Day\-to\-Day)**

* **The Gatekeeper:** Conduct high\-volume prescreen interviews to identify top\-tier talent who align with our company culture and skill requirements.
* **The Scheduler:** You will schedule interviews considering multiple calendar availability, and confirm interviews across multiple time zones and hiring managers.
* **The Guide:** Manage the end\-to\-end onboarding process, ensuring new hires feel welcomed, informed, and equipped from day one. Follow up after onboarding with a review of policies.
* **The Workspace Guru:** Utilize the full Google Workspace ecosystem (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive, and Gmail) as well as other software platforms to track candidate pipelines, and keep documentation and record keeping flawless. Verify daily clock in/outs.
* **The Coordinator:** Handle administrative logistics with precision—verifying licensing, submitting for background screenings, and setting up new hire profiles.
* **The Prioritizer:** Juggle multiple hiring timelines simultaneously while ensuring an elite, high\-touch candidate experience.

**Who You Are**

* **A Master of Detail:** You double\-check everything. Spelling errors on forms, calendar invite mishaps, or missed steps in a process simply don't happen on your watch.
* **Fast\-Paced \& Flexible:** You don’t just handle change; you thrive on it. Fast\-moving timelines and shifting schedule priorities keep you energized.
* **Google Workspace Fluent:** You know Google Calendar inside and out (including managing shared calendars and complex invites) and can confidently navigate Docs, Sheets, and Drive to keep data organized.
* **An Elite Multitasker:** You can adjust an interview schedule, respond to a candidate email, and prep for your next prescreen call without breaking a sweat. You work independently and are familiar with general clerical duties such as filing and scanning, among others.
* **A People Person:** You possess exceptional communication skills and a warm, professional demeanor that immediately puts candidates and internal teams at ease.

**Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience, recruitment coordination, talent acquisition, or a high\-volume administrative role.
* Advanced proficiency with **Google Workspace** (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets).
* Proven track record of handling heavy calendar management and scheduling.
* Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive, confidential employee information with total discretion.
* Able to pass background check, drug screening and reference verification.
* Business casual dress is required for this front desk position.

**What’s In It For You?**

* A vibrant, supportive, and collaborative team culture.
* Room for professional and career growth.
* Contributing to the safety of others.

**How to Apply**

Ready to jump into the fast lane with us? Apply now!

Pay: $23\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Paid training

Shift availability:

* Day Shift (Required)

Ability to Commute:

* Richardson, TX 75080 (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Manager, Implementation (IT)
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

 **About the role**


Rippling’s Product Specialist team ensures customers see incredible business transformation through Rippling's most complex products.


Our engagements are consultative. Our specialists deeply understand the customers’ unique pain points, offer creative solutions, and build/set up their Rippling environment to address their needs. Hence, our specialists serve as a bridge between the customer and product teams. They are instrumental in driving adoption.


As a Manager, IT Implementation, you will lead a team of \~7 global specialists to drive the exponential impact of adoption and customer lifetime value (LTV) across Rippling’s IT product offerings (Identity and Access Management, Device Management, Inventory Management, and Third\-Party IdP).


The ideal candidate has a proven track record of leading client\-facing implementation, professional services, or technical client support teams in a fast\-paced B2B SaaS environment, combined with the technical ability needed to guide specialists through complex customer environments.

 **What you will do**

* Direct a global team of IT Product Specialists, fostering accountability, continuous professional development, and execution excellence.
* Lead the front\-line execution of IT implementations from client kickoff through go\-live, ensuring your team hits key milestones and maximizes product adoption.
* Identify and mitigate risks associated with implementation projects, act as an escalation point for complex client implementations and technical issues
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Rippling Sales, Technical Account Management, and Support teams to create a seamless customer journey
* Collaborate with Product \& Engineering to continuously improve product functionality based on customer feedback in Implementation
* Monitor key performance metrics and continuous improvement on KPIs while helping to optimize playbooks and frameworks for increased simplicity and efficiency

 **What you will need**

* 2\+ years of professional experience directly managing teams within a customer\-facing organization, such as Professional Services, Customer Implementation and Technical Client Support.
* 5\+ years of overall experience in customer onboarding or software implementation, with a clear understanding of managing external customer relationships and project timelines. **E****xperience working with external facing customers required.**
* Strong foundational knowledge of corporate IT landscapes. You must be comfortable coaching a team that works daily with MDM, identity provisioning (SSO, SAML/OIDC), Zero Touch deployment, and Endpoint Lifecycle Management (e.g., Google Workspace, Azure AD, Okta).
* A track record of developing, tracking, and optimizing operational metrics, team capacity, and project timelines.
* Self\-starter with a bias towards action, energized by ambiguity and a fast\-paced environment, with a strong desire to build.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

  

This role will receive a competitive salary \+ benefits \+ equity. The salary for US\-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.

  

A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below.

jobs.title: Implementation Consultant I
jobs.description:
**Implementation Consultant, Amper at ECI**

  

  

**About the Role**  

ECI is seeking an experienced Implementation Consultant to support the successful deployment of Amper, our manufacturing visibility and machine monitoring solution. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong project management, technical implementation, and manufacturing operations knowledge with a highly customer\-focused approach.

  

  

The Implementation Consultant will lead customers through the post\-sale onboarding journey, from kickoff through go\-live, ensuring Amper is configured, installed, and adopted effectively within each customer’s environment. This person will serve as a trusted advisor to manufacturers, helping them determine the best approach for hardware placement, machine connectivity, shop floor setup, and software configuration to maximize operational value.

  

  

Success in this role requires someone who understands how manufacturing machines work, can communicate confidently with plant leaders, operators, IT teams, and engineers, and can guide customers through both the technical and operational aspects of implementation. An engineering background and comfort working in industrial environments are strongly preferred.

  

  

**About Amper**

  

  

Amper helps manufacturers gain real\-time visibility into shop floor operations through easy\-to\-deploy machine monitoring and production intelligence. By connecting manufacturing equipment and turning machine data into actionable insights, Amper enables customers to improve uptime, productivity, and decision\-making across their operations.

  

  

As part of ECI’s portfolio, Amper supports manufacturers in modernizing operations with practical, scalable technology designed for the realities of the shop floor.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**


* Own customer implementations from post\-sale kickoff through successful go\-live, ensuring projects are delivered on time and aligned to customer expectations.
* Serve as the primary implementation lead and trusted advisor during onboarding, installation, configuration, and early adoption.
* Assess customer manufacturing environments and recommend effective approaches for hardware placement, machine connectivity, and system setup.
* Advise customers on how and where to connect Amper to manufacturing equipment based on machine type, operating environment, and production workflows.
* Work directly with customer stakeholders including plant managers, manufacturing engineers, maintenance teams, IT teams, and operations leaders to ensure successful deployment.
* Configure software and support customers through setup, testing, validation, and training.
* Partner with customers to align Amper’s capabilities to their specific manufacturing processes, business goals, and reporting needs.
* Lead implementation project plans, including timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, and communication across multiple stakeholders.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve technical and operational challenges during implementation, escalating when needed.
* Support integrations and data flow discussions between Amper and customer systems, including ERP, MES, or other manufacturing software where applicable.
* Deliver user enablement and training to help customers achieve fast time to value.
* Document implementation requirements, technical decisions, configurations, and best practices.
* Collaborate closely with internal teams including Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure a seamless customer experience.
* Provide feedback from the field to Product and Engineering teams to improve implementation processes, product usability, and customer outcomes.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of implementation playbooks, documentation, and scalable onboarding processes.


**What Success Looks Like**


* Customers are implemented efficiently and successfully with minimal friction.
* Hardware is installed appropriately and machine connectivity is achieved accurately and reliably.
* Customers reach go\-live quickly and begin realizing operational value early in the relationship.
* Implementation projects are managed proactively, with clear communication and strong stakeholder alignment.
* Technical and operational issues are resolved effectively and professionally.
* Customers view the Implementation Consultant as a knowledgeable, credible partner who understands manufacturing and can guide best practices.


**Qualifications**


* 3–5\+ years of experience in a customer\-facing implementation, solutions consulting, technical account management, solutions engineering, industrial engineering, or similar role.
* Experience working in or with manufacturing environments is required.
* Strong understanding of shop floor operations, industrial equipment, and manufacturing processes.
* Ability to understand how machines operate and advise on practical methods for connectivity, hardware deployment, and implementation in production settings.
* Engineering background preferred, such as manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Strong project management skills with experience leading complex implementations involving multiple stakeholders and timelines.
* Proven ability to manage several projects at once while maintaining strong attention to detail and follow\-through.
* Technical aptitude with software systems, system configuration, integrations, networking fundamentals, and troubleshooting.
* Experience with manufacturing software such as ERP, MES, or machine monitoring platforms is highly preferred.
* Familiarity with systems such as Epicor, SAP, Plex, JobBOSS, or similar platforms is a plus.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Comfortable working directly with customers onsite and remotely in industrial and production environments.
* Highly organized, proactive, and customer\-oriented with a strong sense of ownership.


**Preferred Skills**


* Experience with industrial hardware, sensors, gateways, or machine connectivity solutions.
* Knowledge of CNC, fabrication, injection molding, or other discrete manufacturing environments.
* Experience coordinating across operations, IT, engineering, and executive stakeholders.
* Familiarity with implementation methodologies, customer onboarding frameworks, and change management.
* Experience using CRM and project management tools such as Salesforce, Jira, Asana, Monday.com, or similar platforms.
* Ability to analyze implementation progress and customer outcomes using dashboards, reports, and data\-driven metrics.


**Why Join ECI / Amper**


* Opportunity to work with innovative technology that is transforming manufacturing operations.
* High\-impact role with direct influence on customer success, adoption, and long\-term retention.
* Collaborative environment with cross\-functional partnership across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success.
* Ability to work closely with manufacturers and help solve real operational challenges on the shop floor.
* Competitive compensation and benefits in a growing, mission\-driven organization.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**


The Implementation Consultant I reports to the Manager of Implementation Services. You will help customers successfully implement ECI Software Solutions by leveraging your knowledge of the software's capabilities and limitations to deliver effective implementation solutions. You will also be responsible for facilitating customer training and promoting knowledge sharing within the implementation team.


**Essential Job Duties**


* Successfully implement ECI software solutions and provide ongoing consulting services, delivering an exceptional customer experience while gaining a thorough understanding of each customer's business processes.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for customers throughout the implementation process.
* Lead customer sessions with the objective of identifying and documenting: Current and future business initiatives, Gap analysis within current systems and/or processes, and Reporting / data analytics requirements.
* Implement the software, considering aspects such as timeline, budget, scope, and delivery, following the implementation methodology and agreements with the Manager of Implementation Services.
* Understand and deliver upon the ECI implementation methodology, which includes the ability to complete:
	+ Requirements gathering through existing process reviews
	+ Systems design and fit\-gap analysis
	+ System configuration and setup
	+ Engineer solutions based on complicated customer business requirements
	+ New process design and definition
	+ Pre\-implementation system testing
	+ Concept validation and user acceptance testing
	+ Data migration and data formatting recommendations
	+ Go\-live implementation tasks and post\-go\-live consulting
	+ Consulting recap/activity reporting
	+ Ensure timely and accurate project and time administration
* Identify and manage potential issues and escalations in coordination with the Manager of Implementation Services or project manager
* Work is generally independent and collaborative in nature. Contributes to moderately complex aspects of a project.
* Maintain awareness of project budgets and the solution sold to the customer, proactively managing implementation activities to align with project scope and budget expectations.


**Required Education (preferred)**


Bachelor’s Degree


**Preferred Education (not required)**


Master’s Degree


**Degree Focus**


Business Management, Accounting, Supply Chain, Information Systems, or equivalent


**Years of Experience Required**


1 – 3 years


**Specialty/Industry Experience**


Software implementation or consultation experience. Lumber Building Material Industry


**Management Experience**


N/A


**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Requirements**


* Strong knowledge of ERP systems; ERP implementation experience preferred.
* Understanding of common business practices in manufacturing, distribution, retail, operations, and finance.
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to users with varying levels of technical expertise through virtual interactions.
* Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Possess fundamental technical networking knowledge to assist customers with troubleshooting, along with a basic proficiency in configuring and managing various Windows printer connection types.


**Travel Requirements**


Travel is not a regular requirement for this position. However, occasional travel may be requested to support customer implementations, customer meetings, training, or special projects. Any travel will be based on business needs and employee availability.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Implementation & Strategy
jobs.description:
**Reports To**: Director of Tobacco Control Health Initiatives

**Employee Status**: Full Time, Exempt

**Location/Office:** New York, NY (CAI has a hybrid work schedule of working 2 days in the office and 3 days remote.)

 **General Statement of Responsibilities**


The Senior Program Manager works under the direction of the Director of Tobacco Control Health Initiatives to manage day\-to\-day implementation of CAI's tobacco control health initiatives, with a primary focus on the SAMHSA\-funded National Center of Excellence for Tobacco\-Free Recovery (CoE\-TFR). The role supports the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of technical assistance (TA) that builds the capacity of state department of health teams to work across departments, with provider networks, and people with lived experience to strengthen behavioral health and recovery systems to ensure access to evidence\-based tobacco use treatment (TUT) as part of routine care.

 **Major Tasks and Responsibilities (include, but are not limited to):**

* Manage day\-to\-day implementation of CoE\-TFR activities, translating project goals and priorities into implementation plans, timelines, and deliverables.
* Manage core components of the Tobacco\-Free Recovery Learning Community, including: state engagement, completion of key assessment activities, convening state\-specific Leadership Academies, development of state\-specific action plans, and implementation support.
* Serve as primary point of contact for assigned state teams, maintaining regular communication, coordination and delivery of individualized pro\-active and on\-demand TA (virtual and in\-person) to support progress toward development and implementation of state\-specific action plans.
* Apply implementation science and quality improvement approaches to assess progress and adapt strategies.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with state and national partners, consultants, and stakeholders
* Support meaningful engagement of people with lived and living experience, peers, and families in project activities and systems\-change efforts.
* Collaborate with evaluation staff to implement evaluation activities and use data and feedback to continuously improve TA and capacity\-building strategies.
* Collaborate with communications staff to promote national dissemination of project resources, webinar trainings, and project findings.
* Collaborate with curriculum staff to support the development of learning session designs and resources, and e\-learning and video\-based learning tools.
* Develop and monitor project workplans, timelines, milestones, and deliverables; proactively flag implementation challenges and areas needing additional support.
* Plan, facilitate, and document internal and external meetings; contribute to reports, presentations, briefs, and success stories, documenting outcomes and lessons learned.
* Maintain and document all activities in project management database ensuring quality and completeness of all data and to use for project monitoring and improvement.
* Support the Director in preparing for funder meetings, national partner engagement, and other strategic activities; represent CAI at state and national meetings and conferences as appropriate.
* Support budget monitoring, consultant/partner coordination, and reporting requirements; contribute to broader portfolio growth, including partnership and proposal development.
* Perform other duties as assigned to support project and organizational priorities.

 **Qualifications**

* Master's degree in public health, social work, healthcare administration, health policy, behavioral health, or related field, and/or 5\+ years of relevant professional experience.
* Demonstrated experience managing public health, behavioral health, healthcare, tobacco control, TA, or health systems improvement initiatives.
* Knowledge of behavioral health and recovery systems and the policy, workforce, and service\-delivery factors that drive systems change.
* Familiarity with tobacco/nicotine use and evidence\-based tobacco use treatment, including integration into healthcare, behavioral health, and recovery settings.
* Applied experience designing and delivering technical assistance, capacity building, coaching, or training, and facilitating multidisciplinary or stakeholder groups.
* Strong project management skills across multiple partners, workstreams, and deliverables; excellent facilitation, presentation, and written/oral communication skills.
* Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and know when to escalate issues to leadership.
* Knowledge of implementation science, quality improvement, or performance management approaches, and staff supervision experience, preferred.
* Experience working with state/local government agencies, healthcare or behavioral health systems, or community\-based and recovery organizations, preferred.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and virtual TA/collaboration platforms.
* Willingness to travel approximately 15–20% annually, nationally and within New York State, for Leadership Academies, TA, and meetings.

 **Physical Demands**


These physical demands are representative of the physical requirements necessary for an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the Senior Program Manager’s job. Reasonable accommodation can be made to enable people with disabilities to perform the described essential functions of the Senior Program Manager’s job.

  

While performing the Senior Program Manager’s responsibilities, the employee is required to talk and hear. This position requires the employee to be on\-site at a CAI office. The employee is often required to sit and work at a desk for prolonged periods of time and use their hands and fingers to handle or feel. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, reach with arms and hands, climb or balance, and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times. Vision abilities required by this job include close vision.

  

This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of the Senior Program Manager’s position and it is not intended to be an exhaustive list of skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities or working conditions associated with the position. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

**Compensation**
----------------


The salary range for this position is $85,000 \- $97,000, depending on experience. CAI offers the following benefits:

* Medical, dental and vision insurance
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Flexible spending Account (FSA)
* Dependent Care Account (DCA)
* Transit Reimbursement Account
* Life Insurance – company sponsored up to $50,000
* Long term disability (LTD)
* Short term disability (STD)
* 401K retirement plan after three (3\) months of employment
* Semi\-monthly payroll, the 15th and last day of each month
* Flexible and Hybrid work schedules
* Ability to work fully remotely up to 3 weeks each calendar year


Vacation and Leave benefits:

* 11 Holidays per year
* 2 Floating holidays days year
* 12 Sick days per year
* 15 Vacation days per year for this role, increasing after 4 years of service
* 1 Cancer Screening Day per year
* Bereavement Leave
* Jury Duty Leave
* CAI is an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Implementation Consultant I
jobs.description:
R1 is the leading provider of technology\-driven solutions that transform the patient experience and financial performance of hospitals, health systems, and physician groups. We combine deep healthcare expertise, a global workforce, and advanced capabilities across analytics, AI, intelligent automation, and workflow orchestration to help healthcare organizations improve performance at scale.


As an Implementation Consultant I, you will support the deployment and implementation of the Entri Product Suite, working with clients and internal hospital operations, application, and infrastructure teams to design, build, test, and launch patient and user experience solutions. This entry\-level role within Configuration and Deployment initially supports a limited product scope, with the opportunity and expectation to learn and progress quickly.


You will help move projects from planning through go\-live by gathering client data and requirements, supporting application database builds, coordinating testing and readiness activities, developing educational materials, and keeping stakeholders informed and accountable. This is a strong opportunity for someone who is organized, proactive, client\-focused, eager to learn, and comfortable solving workflow and implementation challenges in a collaborative environment.


**Responsibilities**

* Partner with clients and internal hospital operations, application, and infrastructure teams to support the design, build, and implementation of Entri patient and user experience solutions.
* Support on\-time, accurate delivery of application database builds and communicate progress, risks, and support needs across the deployment team.
* Consult with clients and project partners to define and obtain the data needed to configure applications based on contract scope, client needs, project timelines, and budget.
* Analyze data and operational workflows to identify standard best practices, improve efficiency, and solve implementation challenges creatively.
* Coordinate with clients, Operations, Training, IT, Product, Integration, Support, and other project partners to meet implementation milestones and prepare for go\-live.
* Develop and deliver clear training, objectives, expectations, and educational materials for end users and project stakeholders.
* Lead or support database validation, functional testing, and integrated testing to confirm readiness for successful go\-lives.
* Identify project obstacles, engage the appropriate subject matter experts, and escalate or resolve issues that could affect solution delivery.
* Provide clear project updates and escalations to stakeholders at multiple levels and help maintain accountability throughout implementation.
* Propose opportunities to improve, enhance, or expand product and process initiatives.
* Build knowledge of healthcare operations and patient access workflows while progressing through product training, mock implementation work, shadowing, and supported client projects.
* Travel to client sites based on project needs, with the ability to travel up to 50%.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree.
* 1\-3 years of related experience in healthcare, technology, implementation, deployment, project coordination, configuration, client service, or a related field.
* Proficient computer skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio.
* Highly organized, with strong interpersonal skills and clear, concise oral and written communication.
* Ability to present information effectively and respond to questions from managers, clients, office staff, peers, and other stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and critical\-thinking skills, including the ability to collect information, establish facts, draw conclusions, and correct errors.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines, work effectively under pressure, and adjust to rapidly changing customer needs.
* Self\-motivation and the ability to work independently without close supervision while contributing effectively within a collaborative team.
* Ability to handle confidential information with integrity and understand the importance of protecting patient data, including HIPAA requirements.
* Ability to understand, read, write, and speak English and prepare professional business correspondence.
* Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% based on project needs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Healthcare experience, particularly in patient access, registration, scheduling, hospital operations, or related workflows.
* Experience supporting software implementation, product deployment, application configuration, database build, or project management activities.
* Experience with healthcare platforms or electronic medical record systems such as Epic or Cerner.
* Experience with Schedule Maximizer, Order Facilitator, Consumer Self Scheduling, Looker Reporting, or related Entri tools.
* Comfort working directly with clients, facilitating meetings, delivering demonstrations or training, and navigating challenging stakeholder interactions.
* Ability to learn new products and processes quickly, ask thoughtful clarifying questions, apply constructive feedback, and remain effective through a steep learning curve.
* Collaborative, energetic approach with a focus on team success, continuous learning, and professional growth.

For this US\-based position, the base pay range is $54,661\.00 \- $85,842\.89 per year . Individual pay is determined by role, level, location, job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
The healthcare system is always evolving — and it’s up to us to use our shared expertise to find new solutions that can keep up. On our growing team you’ll find the opportunity to constantly learn, collaborate across groups and explore new paths for your career.  



  

Our associates are given the chance to contribute, think boldly and create meaningful work that makes a difference in the communities we serve around the world. We go beyond expectations in everything we do. Not only does that drive customer success and improve patient care, but that same enthusiasm is applied to giving back to the community and taking care of our team — including offering a competitive benefits package.

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**


Job Description
Qualifacts is a leading provider of behavioral health software and SaaS solutions for clinical productivity, compliance and state reporting, billing, and business intelligence. Its mission is to be an innovative and trusted technology and end\-to\-end solutions partner, enabling exceptional outcomes for its customers and those they serve. Qualifacts’ comprehensive portfolio, including the CareLogic®, Credible™, and InSync® platforms, spans and serves the entire behavioral health, rehabilitative, and human services market supporting non\-profit Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinics (CCBHC) as well as for\-profit large enterprise and small business providers. Qualifacts has a loyal customer base, with more than 2,500 customers representing 75,000 providers serving more than 6 million patients. Qualifacts was recognized in the 2022 and 2023 Best in KLAS: Software and Services report as having the top ranked Behavioral Health EHR solutions.


If you want to work inside an atmosphere where innovation has purpose, and your ambition works to support our customers and those they serve, please apply today!

**We are seeking candidates in Nashville or Tampa to work a hybrid schedule in either office location. Remote candidates will not be considered.**

**Summary of the Clinical Implementation Specialist**


We are seeking a Clinical Implementation Specialist to join our team and play a critical role in guiding new customers through the entire implementation lifecycle of our healthcare technology solutions. This position requires a blend of clinical expertise, technical knowledge, and exceptional communication skills to ensure successful adoption and compliance with state and reporting requirements.

**Responsibilities for the Clinical Implementation Specialist**

* Assess clinical practices, state reporting, and patient treatment requirements; develop collaborative solutions and present recommendations
* Lead new customer implementations from kickoff through go\-live, ensuring a smooth and efficient process
* Resolve client inquiries promptly, maintaining ownership through resolution
* Maintain project documentation and communicate updates via agendas, minutes, and project management tools
* Build and sustain positive, productive relationships with customers and internal teams
* Apply consultative techniques to identify configuration requirements and implement best practices
* Review and validate software configurations with customer implementation teams
* Ensure quality of configured features and prepare customers for effective end\-user training
* Complete product training and demonstrate adaptability across multiple EHR platforms
* Creatively resolve and assess a wide range of issues, suggesting alternative approaches as needed
* Document and track all customer state and reporting requirements to ensure compliance
* Record all customer interactions in CRM according to established standards
* Participate in on\-site visits as needed to gather data and understand workflows

**Qualifications of the Clinical Implementation Specialist**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required
* Clinical experience in behavioral health or general healthcare
* SaaS/cloud implementation experience; EHR/EMR experience preferred

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities of the Clinical Implementation Specialist**

* Strong remote collaboration skills
* Data visualization and reporting analysis expertise
* Familiarity with CCBHC and state\-specific clinical requirements (NY or CA preferred)
* Knowledge of HIPAA compliance
* Exceptional customer service and communication skills (written \& oral)
* Quick, logical problem\-solving with attention to detail and follow\-through
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Ability to travel up to 25%

Qualifacts is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Implementation Specialist**
=============================

**About the Role**
------------------


Prospyr is looking for an **Implementation Specialist** to help new customers successfully transition onto Prospyr and get their teams operational as quickly and confidently as possible.


You’ll own the implementation process from post\-sale handoff through go\-live, coordinating configuration, data migration, workflows, training, and launch readiness.


This role is highly project\-oriented. You'll manage multiple implementations simultaneously while working closely with customers and internal teams to keep projects organized, remove blockers, and ensure customers are prepared to operate successfully in Prospyr.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

### **Implementation Project Management**

* Own customer implementations from Sales handoff through successful go\-live.
* Build and manage implementation plans, milestones, responsibilities, and timelines.
* Coordinate customer and internal stakeholders throughout the project.
* Identify risks, dependencies, and blockers early and drive them toward resolution.
* Maintain clear communication around project status and next steps.

### **Platform Configuration**

* Guide customers through configuration of their Prospyr environment.
* Help customers translate existing operational workflows into Prospyr.
* Coordinate setup across areas such as:


	+ Providers and staff
	+ Locations
	+ Scheduling
	+ Services and catalog
	+ Forms and consents
	+ Payments
	+ Patient communications
	+ Inventory
	+ Memberships
	+ Online booking
	+ Integrations and other applicable features
* Validate configuration prior to go\-live.

### **Data Migration \& Integrations**

* Coordinate data migration requirements between customers and internal technical teams.
* Help customers understand what data is required and how it should be prepared.
* Track migration progress and validate readiness with the customer.
* Coordinate third\-party integrations and dependencies when applicable.
* Escalate technical blockers with clear documentation and business impact.

### **Training \& Go\-Live Readiness**

* Coordinate and deliver role\-based customer training.
* Ensure administrators, providers, front\-desk teams, and other users understand the workflows relevant to their roles.
* Develop a clear go\-live readiness checklist for each implementation.
* Identify knowledge gaps before launch and coordinate additional training where needed.
* Provide additional support during the transition into live operations.

### **Process Improvement**

* Identify recurring implementation friction and opportunities to improve Prospyr's onboarding process.
* Help develop implementation templates, playbooks, checklists, documentation, and training resources.
* Partner with Product and Engineering on recurring implementation blockers.
* Help move repeatable onboarding activities toward scalable self\-service experiences.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Customers launch on time with minimal disruption to their businesses.
* Implementation timelines and responsibilities are clear to customers and internal teams.
* Data migration and configuration issues are identified before go\-live.
* Customers enter ongoing CX management with strong platform knowledge and clearly defined workflows.
* Time\-to\-value and time\-to\-go\-live improve as implementation processes become more standardized.
* Fewer post\-launch support issues originate from incomplete configuration or training.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 2–4\+ years of SaaS implementation, onboarding, project management, or customer success experience.
* Strong project\-management and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple customer implementations simultaneously.
* Comfortable learning complex software and becoming highly proficient in product configuration.
* Strong customer communication and training skills.
* Ability to troubleshoot problems and coordinate effectively with technical teams.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving environment where processes continue to evolve.
* Healthcare, EMR, medical aesthetics, wellness, payments, or vertical SaaS experience is a plus.

**Role Philosophy**
-------------------


Implementation owns the question:

**“What needs to happen to get this customer successfully live on Prospyr?”**


The Implementation Specialist drives that process from beginning to end, while creating a clean transition to the CXM who will own the customer's long\-term success.

The Plant Training Specialist is responsible for the design, development, and execution of a wide variety of Learning \& Development processes, programs, systems, and performance support materials. jobs.description:
**About the Role**



iCapital is seeking a Vice President to join its Implementation team as a senior team lead for Annuities. The Implementation team sits within the Product organization and is responsible for managing platform integrations for both new and existing clients as well as managing the ongoing platform experience for existing clients in close partnership with Product Managers and Relationship Managers.


**Responsibilities**


* Drive successful end\-to\-end annuity implementations for new and existing iCapital clients, including broker\-dealers, Independent Marketing Organizations, carriers, and strategic technology partners.
* Provide program and project management expertise including framing the project, establishing detailed project plans, managing risk and driving accountability across internal and external stakeholders.
* Retain an in\-depth understanding of the iCapital annuities platform to lead or facilitate client discovery, requirements gathering, operating model and business process design, platform setup, testing, and rollout.
* Lead integrations involving annuity marketplaces, order entry platforms, eApplication providers, carrier connectivity, holdings integrations, and related annuity workflows.
* Manage the overall platform experience for existing clients, including maximizing adoption and utilization of annuity products and capabilities.
* Build a strong understanding of a client’s business and how that translates to the iCapital platform; Provide Product Managers and other internal stakeholders with client context to assess change management activities including new product enhancements.
* Collaborate with Product Managers to identify product gaps and opportunities, vet potential solutions and roll out new features.
* Partner closely with the Product Management, Relationship Management, Sales, Operations, Client Success, and external technology teams to deliver for clients.


**Qualifications**


* 10\+ years of experience in project management, client software implementations, relationship management within financial services, insurance, annuities, or fintech
* Knowledge of wealth management, insurance distribution, broker\-dealer operations, and annuity business processes
* Knowledge of annuity products, carrier ecosystems, and annuity order entry and eApplication workflows
* Proven track record of leading cross\-functional project teams from inception to execution
* Familiar with software\-based financial solutions (transaction systems, online forms, trading software)
* Excellent writing skills and able to produce detailed project documentation, business requirements documentation and specifications to drive successful development
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills, and the proven ability to influence and communicate effectively across both internal and client stakeholders
* History of teamwork, willingness to roll up one’s sleeves and get the job done, and a desire to work in a fast\-moving entrepreneurial environment
* Experience managing technology integrations is a plus

  


**Benefits**



The base salary range for this role is $145,000 to $185,000\. iCapital offers a compensation package which includes salary, equity for all full\-time employees, and an annual performance bonus. Employees also receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes an employer matched retirement plan, generously subsidized healthcare with 100% employer paid dental, vision, telemedicine, and virtual mental health counseling, parental leave, and unlimited paid time off (PTO).



We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office Monday\-Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Friday.

  



For additional information on iCapital, please visit https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about\-us Twitter: @icapitalnetwork \| Awards Disclaimer: https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about\-us/recognition/
